Creates a page to validate the records by ear

Source: R/validation.R
create_validation.Rd

BirdNET makes mistakes, above all with species that are rare at the site or detected with low confidence. This function prepares a validation page (<output>/validation/AudioMoth_<ID>_validation.html) to check the records before exporting them to Observation.org:

Usage

create_validation(
  am,
  min_confidence = 0.5,
  min_detections = 1,
  n_clips = 2,
  margin_s = 1,
  spectrograms = TRUE,
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

am

An audiomoth object with detections (see analyze_birdnet()).

min_confidence

Only detections with at least this confidence are grouped into records.

min_detections

Minimum number of detections of the species in the day for the record to be validated.

n_clips

Audio clips per record (the best detections, from different recordings).

margin_s

Seconds of audio before and after each detection.

spectrograms

Draw the spectrogram of each clip (slower).

open

Open the page in the browser.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the HTML page.

Details

  • one card per species and day (the unit of a record of Observation.org), sorted from the least plausible to the most plausible: the product of the highest confidence and the probability of occurrence of the species at the site and week (BirdNET metadata model, when known);

  • for each record, n_clips audio clips of the best detections (from different recordings) with their spectrograms;

  • buttons to mark the record as valid, not valid or unsure, a box to choose another species (with autocompletion among the BirdNET species) and a comment.

The page works offline in any browser, without R (the validation/ folder can be sent to someone else). Decisions are kept in the browser while working; the button Download decisions (CSV) saves them as AudioMoth_<ID>_validation.csv. Then export_observation() applies them automatically: it looks for that file in the validation folder and in the Downloads folder (see read_validation()). A spreadsheet can also be used instead of the page: fill in the columns decision (valid, invalid or unsure) and new_name of the CSV file of the validation folder.

Running the function again (e.g. after analysing more recordings) keeps the decisions already saved in the validation folder.

Examples

# \donttest{
card <- system.file("extdata", "example", "card", package = "AudiomothR")
am <- read_audiomoth(card, coordinates = "41.00, -3.00", output = tempfile())
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233720ae1340 is in the temporary folder of R: it is
#>   deleted when R closes.
#>   For your own recordings give a folder of your own, e.g. `output =
#>   "~/AudiomothR_results/box_01"`.
#> 
#> ── AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Folder: /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/AudiomothR/extdata/example/card
#> • Site of this card: AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 (41, -3; ±698 m; source:
#> argument)
#> • Map: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=41&mlon=-3#map=15/41/-3>
#> • Recordings: 16 in 2 days (2026-10-07 to 2026-10-15, Europe/Madrid time)
#> • Audio: 48,000 Hz, gain Medium, 0.7 min in total
#> • 10 with problems: duration < 3 s
#> • Battery: 4.9 V → 4.5 V
#> • Temperature: 11.7 to 34.4 °C
#> • Results in: /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233720ae1340
am$detections <- read_detections(system.file("extdata", "example",
  "birdnet_detections.csv", package = "AudiomothR"))
page <- create_validation(am, open = FALSE)
#> Preparing the audio clips ■■■■■■■■■■■                       33% | ETA:  3s
#> Preparing the audio clips ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s
#> ✔ Validation page with 3 records in
#>   /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233720ae1340/validation/AudioMoth_FACADE0012345678_validation.html.
#> ℹ Listen and decide, press Download decisions (CSV) and run
#>   `export_observation(am)`: the decisions are applied automatically.
# }
